entities.summary: The Dubai International Stadium, aka the Dubai Sports City Cricket Stadium, is a multi-purpose stadium in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. It is mainly used for cricket and is one of the three main cricket stadiums in the country, the other two being Sharjah Cricket Stadium in Sharjah and Sheikh Zayed Cricket Stadium in Abu Dhabi. It has seating capacity for 25,000 spectators, but it is expandable to accommodate 30,000 spectators. It is a part of the Dubai Sports City in Dubai. The architect of this project was the Canadian architect, Awsam Matloob. DSC Cricket Stadium is a stadium in West Asia. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: The DSC Cricket Stadium has played a significant role in promoting cricket in the UAE and has hosted several international matches, contributing to the growth of the sport in the region. Its presence has also helped to establish Dubai as a major sports hub.
